title: Wear : TT used for bolus calc
symptom: When using the calculator on the Wear tiles, TT (temporary target) is used in calculations even though the phone calculator has 'use TT' unchecked. The user cannot find where to turn it off on the watch.
cause: The Wear plugin has its own setting that controls whether TT is accounted for in Wear calculations, separate from the phone calculator settings.
fix: Disable the TT setting in the Wear plugin settings to prevent TT from being used in Wear calculations.
evidence_quote: Check Wear plugin settings. This controls if TT should be accounted for or not in Wear. If you disable it you won't see (TT: xx) if a TT is active.
